note: RISK-ONLY SCOPE. Sanctions: no hit found, but this is NOT a verified negative — the OFAC Sanctions List Search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) requires interactive query submission and returned no machine-readable result; UN, EU, UK OFSI and BIS Entity List were not queried because the DuckDuckGo search backend was down (connection refused) for the whole session and Google returned HTTP 429. Treat sanctions status as UNVERIFIED, not cleared. Court cases: one civil/commercial matter only — Bombay HC Arbitration Application No. 92 of 2021, Precise Chemipharma v. Sterling Hospital & Ors., orders 15.07.2021 and 29.07.2021, K.R. Shriram J. Company is the applicant/claimant, i.e. it is pursuing a claim, not defending one; no criminal or regulatory dimension. Indian Kanoon full-text search for the exact name returned only these 2 documents (same case), so no other reported judgments surfaced. Regulator actions / negative news: none found, but search coverage was severely degraded (see above) — absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence. Credit rating: null — no CRISIL/ICRA/CARE/India Ratings/Acuite action located; not public in sources reachable. RF/CIS supply: null — no evidence of supplies to Russia or CIS found; company site (precisechemipharma.com) states exports to 'almost 30 countries' and API supply to Abbott, Sun Pharma, Teva, Ranbaxy, Dr Reddy's, Pliva, but names no destination countries and makes no Russia/CIS claim; per project rule 5 this is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' and is not a shipment record. Per rule 2, the arbitration matter is not a rejection ground and is noted neutrally. No rejection basis identified in this scope.
